why_no_imagery_source: No accepted project evidence establishes a legal static imagery source covering every launch spot with permitted build-time acquisition, exact credit, refresh terms and zero serving cost. Recorded webcam capture is prohibited, other commercial terms and coverage are unverified, and satellite imagery is unfit at break level. X11 therefore accepted the seed-only orientation diagram as a changed product fulfillment: a spot marker and the declared shore normal, and nothing else.

rejected_sources.tile_api: A visitor-time tile request is a third-party endpoint, a running cost and a tracking surface. Forbidden at every layer.
rejected_sources.browser_map_library: Route JavaScript for a map the page does not need. The document budget and the zero-route-JavaScript rule both refuse it.
rejected_sources.scraped_imagery: No licence, no credit, no refresh terms. Not publishable at any price.
rejected_sources.recorded_webcam_capture: Prohibited by the source terms recorded in the decision record.
rejected_sources.satellite_imagery: Unfit for a break-level diagram and unverified for redistribution.

licence.basis: The diagram is drawn from data/spots/pa-pacific.yaml, this project’s own human-owned seed. No third-party image, tile or basemap is copied, traced or redistributed.
licence.coordinate_credit_required: OpenStreetMap contributors, wherever a coordinate came from OpenStreetMap. Credited in Spanish on the visible caption of every affected spot.
licence.refresh: The asset is regenerated only when its own seed record or the generator version changes. There is no provider refresh clause because there is no provider.

acquisition.when: Before the Astro route build, from the local seed. Never at visitor time.
acquisition.serving_cost: Zero: the asset is a local file emitted into the same static bundle the pages already ship, served from the same origin, and never requested from a third party.

content_rule: The visual may carry only the declared spot marker and the shore-normal arrow. It must not depict or imply a coastline, satellite image, street, boundary, bathymetry, or any precision beyond the cited seed record.
refusal_rules: A launch spot absent from this policy receives no asset.
A launch spot whose visible coordinate credit is empty receives no asset.
A launch spot whose visible orientation credit is empty receives no asset, because no source states which way it faces.
